text:
Pipe A fills the tank at a rate of \( \frac{1}{4} \) tank per hour.  
Pipe B drains the tank at a rate of \( \frac{1}{6} \) tank per hour.

When both are open, the net filling rate is:

\[
\frac{1}{4} - \frac{1}{6}
= \frac{3}{12} - \frac{2}{12}
= \frac{1}{12}
\]

So the tank fills at \( \frac{1}{12} \) of the tank per hour.

Time to fill 1 whole tank:

\[
1 \div \frac{1}{12} = 12
\]

ANSWER: 12
